commands.title: Go to File
commands.description: Fuzzy-find files by path across the workspace folders, honoring .gitignore. Returns {matches:[{path, absPath, positions, line?}], truncated}; positions are rune indexes of the matched characters in path, and a query ending in :N matches without the suffix and puts line N on every match. Unavailable in the home workspace.

query.description: Fuzzy query matched against workspace-relative paths, case-insensitively; empty lists the shortest paths.
